description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named NewLocaleDialog that prompts the user to input a new locale code (e.g., 'en_US') and returns the result via an intent. It provides UI components like buttons and an editable text field for user interaction.

classes.name: NewLocaleDialog
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a dialog allowing the user to input a locale string and select whether to apply or select it, returning the result via an intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds UI elements to variables.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events, retrieves the input locale, determines if the 'add and select' button was pressed, logs the information if debugging is enabled, sets the activity result with the input data, and finishes the activity.
